{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01GFo43aECzpskuXBtoYY1VB","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013QcxodNT5m7EgbjQD8WjYC","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom PIL import Image\nimport numpy as np\n\nimg = Image.open('/root/calendar_page1.png')\nwidth, height = img.size\nprint(f\"Image size: {width} x {height}\")\n\n# Convert to numpy to find time label positions\narr = np.array(img)\n\n# Look for the blue time labels on the left side\n# The time labels are in blue - let's scan the left ~100px for blue pixels\nleft_strip = arr[:, 20:120, :]  # RGB\n\n# Blue pixels: high B, low R, low G\nblue_mask = (left_strip[:,:,2] > 150) & (left_strip[:,:,0] < 100) & (left_strip[:,:,1] < 100)\nblue_rows = np.where(blue_mask.any(axis=1))[0]\n\nif len(blue_rows) > 0:\n    # Group consecutive rows\n    groups = []\n    start = blue_rows[0]\n    prev = blue_rows[0]\n    for r in blue_rows[1:]:\n        if r - prev > 5:\n            groups.append((start, prev))\n            start = r\n        prev = r\n    groups.append((start, prev))\n    \n    print(f\"Found {len(groups)} time label groups:\")\n    for g in groups:\n        mid = (g[0] + g[1]) // 2\n        print(f\"  rows {g[0]}-{g[1]}, midpoint y={mid}\")\nEOF\n","description":"Find pixel positions of time labels in calendar image"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":914,"cache_read_input_tokens":12479,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":914,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01M7pk3S84WsgWKzJu1c7Cfs","session_id":"3d39d471-fb47-479b-b9eb-293aabdb0cfc","uuid":"170cbf3c-681a-4d5d-b125-52823cf4d799"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01Nc5i1reKYYKrepPfJyisgy","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01E97n5jqq2JrbD8LMQCV3qf","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nimg = Image.open('/root/calendar_page1.png')\nwidth, height = img.size\nprint(f\"Image size: {width} x {height}\")\n\n# Scan left strip for blue pixels to find time label y-positions\nblue_rows = []\nfor y in range(height):\n    for x in range(20, 120):\n        r, g, b = img.getpixel((x, y))[:3]\n        if b > 150 and r < 120 and g < 120:\n            blue_rows.append(y)\n            break\n\n# Group consecutive rows\ngroups = []\nif blue_rows:\n    start = blue_rows[0]\n    prev = blue_rows[0]\n    for row in blue_rows[1:]:\n        if row - prev > 5:\n            groups.append((start, prev, (start+prev)//2))\n            start = row\n        prev = row\n    groups.append((start, prev, (start+prev)//2))\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(groups)} time label groups (start, end, mid):\")\nfor i, g in enumerate(groups):\n    print(f\"  {i}: rows {g[0]}-{g[1]}, mid y={g[2]}\")\nEOF\n","description":"Find y-pixel positions of each hour label in calendar image"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":639,"cache_read_input_tokens":13393,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":639,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":66,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01M7pk3S84WsgWKzJu1c7Cfs","session_id":"3d39d471-fb47-479b-b9eb-293aabdb0cfc","uuid":"14eee49b-34eb-4977-b2a8-dd63dc1106aa"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01FBKAJiucjJksoKBdeXUBDf","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HScouThcdZqdcsactCfDu3","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom PIL import Image\n\nimg = Image.open('/root/calendar_page1.png')\nwidth, height = img.size\n\n# Time label midpoints (y pixel) for each hour (index 0 = 12am, 1 = 1am, etc.)\nhour_y = [121, 204, 287, 370, 453, 537, 620, 703, 786, 870, 953, 1036, 1119, 1206, 1289, 1372, 1455, 1538, 1622, 1705, 1788, 1871, 1952, 2035]\n\n# pixels per hour\nspacings = [hour_y[i+1] - {"type":"system","subtype":"task_progress","task_id":"aaf3127d46acea05f","tool_use_id":"toolu_01M7pk3S84WsgWKzJu1c7Cfs","description":"Running Precisely map event block start/end times using PDF grid line calibration","usage":{"total_tokens":33718,"tool_uses":17,"duration_ms":141884},"last_tool_name":"Bash","uuid":"685d19c9-5345-4be6-a059-ad0e78d5759c","session_id":"3d39d471-fb47-479b-b9eb-293aabdb0cfc"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01VYM81pKUcXEupyQdVjDp5h","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Svsz6ZVBRJhRNYpBZaDV5k","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport pdfplumber\n\nwith pdfplumber.open('/root/calendar.pdf') as pdf:\n    page = pdf.pages[0]\n    \n    # The y-coordinate in pdfplumber uses 'top' which is distance from top of page\n    # The lines show the grid. Let me re-calibrate using the actual line positions.\n    \n    # Grid lines are at 15-min intervals based on the spacing\n    # Lines: y=43.89, 51.38, 58.87, 66.36, 73.85, 81.34, 88.84, 96.33 etc.\n    # Each interval = ~7.49 units = 15 minutes\n    # So 1 hour = ~29.96 units (matches our calculation)\n    \n    # The time label positions (from the words):\n    # 12am top=39.2, meaning the 12am label sits at top=39.2\n    # The grid starts at 43.89 which is 12:15am (first quarter-hour line after midnight)\n    \n    # Let me use the grid lines to precisely calibrate\n    # First grid line at 43.89 = 12:15am\n    # This means 12:00am = 43.89 - 7.49 = 36.40 in PDF space\n    \n    # Actually, let's count: the first line is at 43.89, second at 51.38 (diff=7.49)\n    # These are 15-min interval lines\n    # If line[0] at 43.89 is 12:15am, then midnight is at 43.89 - 7.49 = 36.40\n    \n    min_per_unit = 15 / 7.49  # minutes per PDF unit\n    print(f\"Minutes per PDF unit: {min_per_unit:.4f}\")\n    \n    midnight_y = 43.89 - 7.49  # = 36.40\n    print(f\"Midnight y (PDF top): {midnight_y:.2f}\")\n    \n    def pdf_y_to_time_v2(y_top):\n        \"\"\"More precise conversion using grid lines\"\"\"\n        minutes_from_midnight = (y_top - midnight_y) / 7.49 * 15\n        total_min = round(minutes_from_midnight)\n        h = total_min // 60\n        m = total_min % 60\n        if h < 0 or h > 23:\n            return f\"(out of range: {h}:{m:02d})\"\n        if h == 0:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h < 12:\n            return f\"{h}:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h == 12:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}pm\"\n        else:\n            return f\"{h-12}:{m:02d}pm\"\n    \n    # Now map all curves to their start/end times\n    print(\"\\n--- Event blocks (curves) ---\")\n    curves = page.curves\n    for i, c in enumerate(curves):\n        # In pdfplumber, 'top' is distance from top of page\n        top_time = pdf_y_to_time_v2(c['top'])\n        bottom_time = pdf_y_to_time_v2(c['bottom'])\n        color = c.get('non_stroking_color', 'none')\n        print(f\"  Curve {i}: {top_time} to {bottom_time} | top={c['top']:.2f}, bottom={c['bottom']:.2f} | color={color}\")\n    \n    # Verify with known hours\n    print(\"\\n--- Verifying grid against known times ---\")\n    print(f\"  12am label y=39.2 -> {pdf_y_to_time_v2(39.2)}\")\n    print(f\"  9am label y=308.8 -> {pdf_y_to_time_v2(308.8)}\")\n    print(f\"  6pm label y=578.5 -> {pdf_y_to_time_v2(578.5)}\")\nEOF\n","description":"Precisely map event block start/end times using PDF grid line calibration"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2515,"cache_read_input_tokens":30377,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":2515,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":45,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01M7pk3S84WsgWKzJu1c7Cfs","session_id":"3d39d471-fb47-479b-b9eb-293aabdb0cfc","uuid":"083b207c-9b8e-45e8-9ccc-b7865ab3bab4"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01Mt3PTMFBcaFWBmottm7U6L","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01B2GbHPn3v8C8pE6HkX4wGd","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nimport pdfplumber\n\nwith pdfplumber.open('/root/calendar.pdf') as pdf:\n    page = pdf.pages[0]\n    \n    # Lines are at 15-min intervals\n    # First line: y=43.891, spacing: ~7.491 units per 15 min\n    # There's also y=38.891 which is the TOP border line\n    # The first content line (first 15-min mark) = 43.891\n    \n    # The calendar starts at midnight (12:00am). \n    # The first 15-min gridline is at y=43.891\n    # The second is at y=51.381 (diff = 7.490)\n    # Average spacing = 7.490 units per 15 minutes\n    \n    # If 12:00am corresponds to the position BEFORE the first grid line:\n    # 12:00am_y = 43.891 - 7.490 = 36.401\n    # But that doesn't quite work either.\n    \n    # Let's check: the \"Out of office\" label at y=47.4 (top) is positioned inside the block\n    # The block itself starts at curve top=44.89 (which calculates to ~12:17am with our formula)\n    \n    # Actually, looking at the curves:\n    # Curve 2 (morning OOF): top=44.89, bottom=297.57\n    # Curve 0 (evening OOF): top=584.22, bottom=762.00\n    \n    # The evening OOF has explicit label \"6pm - 12am\"\n    # So it starts at 6pm and ends at 12am (midnight)\n    # 6pm label y=578.5, midnight would be the end of the day\n    \n    # Let's use the evening OOF to calibrate:\n    # \"6pm - 12am\" = curve ends at y=762.00 (midnight end) and starts at 6pm\n    # 6pm label y=578.5 \n    # The curve starts at y=584.22 (just after the 6pm label position)\n    \n    # For 6pm, looking at grid: \n    # 6pm = 18 hours * 4 quarter-hours/hour = 72 quarter-hours from midnight\n    # First quarter-hour gridline is at y=43.891\n    # 72 quarter-hours later = 43.891 + 72*7.490 = 43.891 + 539.28 = 583.171\n    # So 6pm is at y=583.17! And curve starts at 584.22 - very close, just a border offset\n    \n    spacing = 7.490  # units per 15 minutes\n    midnight_y = 43.891 - spacing  # = 36.401\n    \n    def y_to_time_precise(y):\n        \"\"\"Convert PDF y (top from page top) to time\"\"\"\n        # Each quarter-hour = 7.490 units\n        # Midnight = 36.401\n        quarter_hours = (y - midnight_y) / spacing\n        total_minutes = round(quarter_hours * 15)\n        h = total_minutes // 60\n        m = total_minutes % 60\n        if h < 0 or h > 24:\n            return f\"(invalid: {h}:{m:02d})\"\n        if h == 24:\n            return \"12:00am (next day)\"\n        if h == 0:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h < 12:\n            return f\"{h}:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h == 12:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}pm\"\n        else:\n            return f\"{h-12}:{m:02d}pm\"\n    \n    # Verify\n    print(\"Calibration checks:\")\n    print(f\"  6pm expected at y=583.171, '6pm' label at y=578.5\")\n    print(f\"  y=583.171 -> {y_to_time_precise(583.171)}\")\n    print(f\"  y=583.891 -> {y_to_time_precise(583.891)} (first line at 6:00 boundary)\")\n    \n    # The grid lines start AFTER midnight (y=43.891 is the first line)\n    # y=38.891 is the top border (which would be just before midnight)\n    # y=43.891 = midnight boundary start? Let's check:\n    print(f\"  y=43.891 (first line) -> {y_to_time_precise(43.891)}\")\n    print(f\"  y=36.401 (midnight_y) -> {y_to_time_precise(36.401)}\")\n    \n    # Let me try midnight_y = 43.891 (i.e. the first gridline IS midnight)\n    def y_to_time_v3(y):\n        midnight = 43.891\n        spacing = 7.490\n        quarter_hours = (y - midnight) / spacing\n        total_minutes = round(quarter_hours * 15)\n        h = total_minutes // 60\n        m = total_minutes % 60\n        if h < 0 or h > 24:\n            return f\"({total_minutes}min = {h}:{m:02d})\"\n        if h == 24 and m == 0:\n            return \"12:00am (next day)\"\n        if h == 0:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h < 12:\n            return f\"{h}:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h == 12:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}pm\"\n        else:\n            return f\"{h-12}:{m:02d}pm\"\n    \n    print(\"\\n--- v3 calibration (first line = midnight) ---\")\n    print(f\"  Evening OOF curve bottom y=762.00 -> {y_to_time_v3(762.00)}\")\n    print(f\"  Evening OOF curve top y=584.22 -> {y_to_time_v3(584.22)}\")\n    # 6pm = 18*4=72 quarter-hours from midnight\n    # y = 43.891 + 72*7.490 = 583.171\n    print(f\"  Expected 6pm at y=583.171 -> {y_to_time_v3(583.171)}\")\n    print(f\"  6pm label at y=578.5 -> {y_to_time_v3(578.5)}\")\n    \n    print(\"\\n--- All events with v3 ---\")\n    for i, c in enumerate(page.curves):\n        top_time = y_to_time_v3(c['top'])\n        bottom_time = y_to_time_v3(c['bottom'])\n        color = c.get('non_stroking_color', 'none')\n        print(f\"  Curve {i}: {top_time} to {bottom_time} | top={c['top']:.3f}, bottom={c['bottom']:.3f} | color={color}\")\nEOF\n","description":"Recalibrate time mapping using evening Out of office known times as reference"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1249,"cache_read_input_tokens":34808,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1249,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":71,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":"toolu_01M7pk3S84WsgWKzJu1c7Cfs","session_id":"3d39d471-fb47-479b-b9eb-293aabdb0cfc","uuid":"1d3c72e9-2406-4107-a0b5-ae986d6556f5"}

v3 gives us midnight_y=43.891 (first gridline = midnight)\n    # This gives: morning OOF top=44.891 -> 12:02am (just barely after midnight - this is a border offset)\n    #             morning OOF bottom=297.571 -> 8:28am\n    # \n    # The evening OOF has label \"6pm - 12am\" explicitly\n    # Curve 0 top=584.223 -> 6:02pm (border), bottom=762.003 -> ~11:58pm (rounding)\n    # 762 + some border = 767 (curve 11 bottom) \n    # Actually the page ends at 792, and curve 0 bottom at 762 is just before the end\n    \n    # The key insight: the curves include border offsets (~2 units)\n    # True start = curve_top rounded to nearest 15-min mark\n    # snap to 15 min\n        h = total_minutes // 60\n        m = total_minutes % 60\n        if h < 0:\n            return \"12:00am\"  # treat as midnight start\n        if h == 0:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h < 12:\n            return f\"{h}:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h == 12:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}pm\"\n        elif h == 24:\n            return \"12:00am (next day)\"\n        else:\n            return f\"{h-12}:{m:02d}pm\"\n    \n    def y_to_time_raw(y):\n        \"\"\"Convert y to time without snapping\"\"\"\n        quarter_hours = (y - midnight) / spacing\n        total_minutes = round(quarter_hours * 15)\n        h = total_minutes // 60\n        m = total_minutes % 60\n        if h < 0:\n            return f\"(-{abs(total_minutes)}min)\"\n        if h == 0:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h < 12:\n            return f\"{h}:{m:02d}am\"\n        elif h == 12:\n            return f\"12:{m:02d}pm\"\n        elif h == 24:\n            return \"12:00am (next day)\"\n        else:\n            return f\"{h-12}:{m:02d}pm\"\n    \n    print(\"FINAL EVENT TIMES (snapped to 15-min marks):\")\n    print(\"=\"*60)\n    \n    #
